_comment: Devotion (systems/devotion.js): prayer and meditation by faith and place, vows, omens, alms by recipient, pilgrimages declared and kept, clergy standing. The soul pact (systems/soulPact.js) is under 'pact'. Every roll comes from the system's own seeded stream.

matchText.same: The rite is your own; the words come easily.
matchText.none: You keep no creed. The prayer is honest, if aimless.
matchText.foreign: The rite here belongs to another faith. You kneel as a guest.
matchText.unaligned: No priest claims this ground. It listens to anyone.

delve.text: In the stillness you see a stair going down into the dark, {dist} hexes to the {dir}. Something waits in {name}.

lair.text: A vision of smoke and stolen goods: outlaws keep a den {dist} hexes to the {dir}.

holy.text: A light rises {dist} hexes to the {dir}: {name}, a holy place you have not yet knelt at.

poi.text: Unbidden, a place comes to you: {name}, {dist} hexes to the {dir}, untouched by any traveller.

none.text: For a moment the veil thins — and shows you only fog.

peace.name: Vow of Peace
peace.desc: Raise no hand in battle or bloodshed for {days} days.

sobriety.name: Vow of Sobriety
sobriety.desc: Set no foot in a taproom and touch no drink for {days} days.

temperance.name: Vow against Dice
temperance.desc: Wager nothing on dice or cards for {days} days.

alms.name: Vow of Alms
alms.desc: Give {gold} gold in alms (temples, the poor, the needy) within {days} days.

pilgrimage.name: Vow of Pilgrimage
pilgrimage._days: Days allowed: baseDays + perWalkDay x the days on foot there, the quickest way (data/travel.json days per hex); a shrine the land does not reach: perHex x hexes as the crow flies.
pilgrimage.desc: Walk to {site} and kneel there within {days} days.

healing.text: The waters close your wounds and wash the fever out.

growth.text: Seeds swell in your fields; the harvest will be heavy.

trade.text: Travellers' luck: your properties will prosper.

military.text: The old bones lend you their courage. No blade will bite you for a day.

arcane.text: The crystals hum a thought you did not have before.

prophecy.text: The moonwell shows you a road.

mystery.text: The drowned bells ring, and you see something far away.

unity.text: At the ancient altar you feel the long line of the faithful behind you.

pilgrimage.text: The relics are carried out for you; the crowd remembers your face.

sacrifice.text: The stone takes its due in blood, and gives back fire.

strangers.name: Master Velloc
strangers.look: a gaunt man in a coat the colour of old wine, whose candle never gutters

strangers.name: the Widow Asheld
strangers.look: a veiled woman who smells of cold ash and pays in coin still warm

strangers.name: Grey Orrin
strangers.look: a smiling pedlar with no shadow on the wall behind him

strangers.name: Lady Mordaunt
strangers.look: a noblewoman no one saw arrive, with rings on every finger and none on her thumbs

pay.label: Pay the debt in gold
pay.text: "Coin was what you wanted. Coin is what I want back — {gold} of it."

cruelty.label: Do a cruel thing
cruelty.text: "Hurt someone who cannot hurt you back. You'll know it when you've done it. So will I."

deceit.label: Tell a damning lie
deceit.text: "Plant a lie about someone great — let it take root and choke them."

dread.label: Make a town fear you
dread.text: "Let a town learn your name the way children learn of wolves."

curse.text: Cold settles in your bones. Dice turn against you, prayers come back unheard.
